title: al-Battani: Opus Astronomicum / Kitab al-Zij, Trilingual Text Reader and Table Reconstructions
version: 2026-06-04 work-level al-Battani package: complete trilingual text reader, fixed-star catalogue, geography gazetteer, and table status
description:
Work-level record for al-Battānī's Opus Astronomicum / Kitāb al-Zīj. Earlier versions of this same Zenodo concept foregrounded the fixed-star catalogue; this version supersedes that presentation and gathers the al-Battānī work package in one place.

The current files include a complete 256-page trilingual text reader for the 100 body-text segments (Arabic source with English and Chinese translations), the Nallino source witness, the canonical v083 TeX/data/report package, a table reference supplement, the complete fixed-star catalogue, the complete geographical gazetteer, and the partial chronology / Canon of Kings layer.

Table status is stated explicitly. The fixed-star catalogue is complete at the current working-edition level: 485 numbered star rows across 47 Ptolemaic figures, with ecliptic longitude and latitude values, north/south signs, magnitudes, modern identification fields, and the documented Escorial-codex lacuna shown in place. The geography gazetteer is complete with 269 locality entries. The chronology layer is useful but partial; ancient regnal-year figures remain flagged for collation. Zodiac / terms / houses auxiliary tables are not cleanly tabulated in Nallino's Latin volume and are not fabricated here.

This record belongs to the broader non-European mathematics manuscript corpus, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20410957, and the main raw/provenance backstop, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20393488.
notes: Complete working fixed-star catalogue: 485 numbered star rows with longitude, latitude, N/S sign, magnitude, modern identifications, and Arabic/English descriptions for every row. The documented source lacuna is shown explicitly rather than silently filled.
